note: English narration split into phrases. Phrase ids are the anchors the film's timeline hangs on; do not rename them. 'pauseAfter' is the intended pause after each phrase (a direction for the voice-over as well as the provisional timing estimate). Calm, unhurried read. 'hold' (optional) is a reading hold added after 'pauseAfter' once a topic has finished building on screen: silence in the voice-over, a still beat in the film.

phrases.text: Maaser sounds simple.
Ten percent.
But once you add income, donations, currencies, different months, recurring commitments and everything that changes along the way,
it quickly becomes harder to keep track.
TEN10 brings it all into one clear system,
with full support for both Maaser and Chomesh, in any currency.
All on the Hebrew calendar too: dates, periods, and a maaser year.
Import existing transactions,
automate recurring entries,
and get reminders when you need them.
The analytics dashboard shows exactly where your household money goes.
For your household budget: cash flow, income versus expenses, and savings rate,
with insights for every period.
Print reports, or export to Excel and PDF.
And TEN10 is more than numbers.
Explore the Halachic Library for relevant guidance,
and when you still have a question, use Ask the Rabbi.
TEN10 was developed with the Torat Ha'adam La'adam Institute, and endorsed by leading rabbis.
Use it on the web from anywhere, or as desktop software that works even offline.
Your income, donations and obligations come together in one clear picture.
TEN10.
Simple and accurate tithe and financial budget management.
Free for personal use.
